label: clean
policy_basis: Generic SQL with no data or secrets
description: A {role} asks for a review of a generic retention query written against a sample schema.
text:
Is this the right way to calculate donor retention year on year?

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN g2.donor_id IS NOT NULL THEN g1.donor_id END) * 1.0
    / COUNT(DISTINCT g1.donor_id) AS retention_rate
FROM gifts g1
LEFT JOIN gifts g2
  ON g1.donor_id = g2.donor_id
  AND g2.gift_year = g1.gift_year + 1
WHERE g1.gift_year = 2024;
